summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 26000 Lead Manager exam and apply social responsibility principles, core subjects, integration, and improvement practices.
audienceIntro: ISO 26000 Lead Manager training suits professionals who coordinate social responsibility assessment, integration, stakeholder engagement, or improvement work. It is relevant when you need to connect ISO 26000 guidance with organizational practices and review how social responsibility is addressed.
prerequisites: To participate, you need a fundamental understanding of social responsibility concepts, issues, and concerns. To receive the PECB Certified ISO 26000 Lead Manager credential, you must pass the relevant exam and meet the certification scheme requirements: five years of professional experience, including two years in social responsibility management; at least 300 hours of social responsibility management project activities; and signing the PECB Code of Ethics. The PECB Certified ISO 26000 Lead Manager exam or equivalent is also required for the credential application.
